description.en: NocoBase is an open-source AI + no-code platform for building business systems fast. Instead of generating everything from scratch, AI works on top of production-proven infrastructure and a WYSIWYG no-code interface, so you get both speed and reliability.
description.zh: 开源AI+无代码平台，用于快速构建业务系统。

audience.zh: 业务人员、开发者、低代码爱好者

usecases.zh: 快速构建业务系统，无需从零编码
usecases.en: Quickly build business systems without coding from scratch
